about.title: About Dhimas
about.p1: Hi, I'm Dhimas, a developer who loves tinkering and discovering workarounds for tricky problems. My interests lie in network engineering and cybersecurity, and I frequently experiment with AI provider routing and self-hosting servers. To me, every problem is fascinating—especially when it calls for unconventional thinking to solve.
about.p2: I also love creating and using quality-of-life software: tools that streamline daily workflows and make computing genuinely practical. If you've got an unusual technical problem without an obvious solution, let's explore it together.
